# cmp

Comparisions

## Index

| Operation     | Description          
|---------------|----------------------
| [`eq`](#eq)   | Equal                
| [`gt`](#gt)   | Greater than

## Operations

### eq

Returns true if *x* and *y* are equal.

Stack effects:
```
( x:Int y:Int -- Bool )
( x:Dec y:Dec -- Bool )
( x:Float/128 y:Float/128 -- Bool )
( x:Rat y:Rat -- Bool )
( x:Complex y:Complex -- Bool )
( x:Text y:Text -- Bool )
```

Example:

| Input      | Stack  
|------------|--------
| `c 5 5 eq` | `true` 
| `c 4 5 eq` | `false`
